snapshot.scope: Workbench public, five private component repositories, and private Integration.
snapshot.method: Read-only GitHub REST API metadata; workflow files were read at each exact default-branch SHA and reduced to inventory metadata. At most 20 primary qualification runs per repository were retained with job states and normalized runner classes. Workbench metrics were calculated with the repository dev ci metrics command from the same date. No workflow was dispatched or rerun.

timing_definitions.run_elapsed_seconds: run updated_at minus created_at; includes any queue interval.
timing_definitions.job_queue_seconds: job started_at minus job created_at when both timestamps are available.
timing_definitions.job_seconds_sum: sum of each observed job interval; parallel jobs overlap and this is not wall-clock duration.

limitations: The organization self-hosted runner inventory endpoint returned HTTP 403; host runner registration and deregistration remain unverified.

Private Actions billing is not available from this read-only API token. The owner-provided dashboard showed the private included Actions minute allowance exhausted with overage blocked; that dashboard was not independently queried in this snapshot.
Custom runner labels, actor identities, branch names, raw logs, workflow source text, secrets, tokens, and source code are excluded. Private run URLs and commit SHAs remain as evidence links.
GitHub-managed workflows have no repository YAML file and are marked GitHub-managed, not stale.
A workflow registered with a missing YAML source is not considered executable qualification. A skipped run is not a pass.
An absent current run does not prove a workflow has never run; the sample is bounded to 20 most recent runs for each primary workflow.

workflows.name: Apply refactor issues from audit PR

definitions.quick_feedback: run creation to last completed quick lane
definitions.workflow_start_wait: workflow run created_at to run_started_at, before jobs are created; missing timestamps are excluded
definitions.job_queue_and_matrix_wait: job created_at to first executed step; includes queue, matrix throttling and runner provisioning
definitions.p95: nearest rank; always report sample count

runner_inventory_permission.error: Requires org admin or runner and runner groups permission
